coverage: The production content index loads byte-identical LOCK 38 V1 data.
The live Road map shows Sukara closed before the Sahila boat mission. Completing the mission opens the 60-minute road from Sahila.
The hub has the locked text and R6 action order, local trust 10, and Road map as the exit.
The cane press operates from 06:00 up to 17:00 outside Friday prayer. A shift takes 90 minutes, pays 5 coins, and gives 1 Sukara trust on the first shift each day.
Sukara's inn costs 3 coins and wakes at 04:40. The masjid resolves by ID, counts once, shows its greeting after the first prayer, and returns to Sukara with Back.
All three residents at trust 10, 50 and 80, the hours boundaries, Friday-prayer presence and all memories, including Murad's memory priority.

All four complete paths: partner and take the share, lend and take 72, lend and take 60, keep the coins. All nine scenes, displayed choices, coin and local trust effects, date-stamped flags and local accounts.
The offers show from 07:00 up to 18:00, with both paid choices hidden at 59 coins and enabled at 60. Only the chosen follow-up opens, after 14 or 30 days respectively.
Q24: Chapter 1 has seven rows and counts the offers once. Both follow-ups have saved completion and hidden hub buttons after Back.
visual_reference: su01–su23. Q15 and R11 set rules-only evidence with zero native captures.
